operation.name: listAvailableEvents
operation.description: Search for events that have live score data available.

parameter.name: eventIds
parameter.description: Optionally restricts the results to the specified event IDs.

parameter.name: eventTypeIds
parameter.description: Optionally restricts the results to the specified event type IDs.

parameter.name: eventStatus
parameter.description: Optionally restricts the results to the specified event status.

exception.description: Generic exception that is thrown if this operation fails for any reason.

operation.name: listScores
operation.description: Returns a list of current scores for the given events.

parameter.name: updateKeys
parameter.description: The filter to select desired markets. All markets that match the criteria in the filter are selected.

exception.description: Generic exception that is thrown if this operation fails for any reason.

operation.name: listIncidents
operation.description: Returns a list of incidents for the given events.

parameter.name: updateKeys
parameter.description: The filter to select desired markets. All markets that match the criteria in the filter are selected.

exception.description: Generic exception that is thrown if this operation fails for any reason.

dataType.name: Incidents
dataType.description: Key/value pairs containing incidents for an event.

dataType.name: Incident
dataType.description: Key/value pairs for a single incident update.

parameter.name: values
parameter.description: Dynamic tennis incident fields. See TennisIncidentValues for documented keys.

dataType.name: Score
dataType.description: Key/value pairs containing the current score for an event.

parameter.name: values
parameter.description: Dynamic tennis score fields. See TennisScoreValues for documented keys.

dataType.name: AvailableEvent
dataType.description: Available event with live score data.

dataType.name: RaceDetails
dataType.description: Race details. Included in the published Scores API type definitions, although not used by the Tennis operations.

parameter.name: lastUpdated
parameter.description: This is the time the data was last updated.

parameter.name: eventTime
parameter.description: This is the eventTime as at the last updated time; format is event type specific.

parameter.name: lastUpdated
parameter.description: This is the time the data was last updated.

parameter.name: updateSequence
parameter.description: This is the unique identifier associated to each update of the data.

parameter.name: updateType
parameter.description: This is the type of update.

dataType.name: UpdateKey
dataType.description: Key/value pairs used to request score or incident updates.

parameter.name: lastUpdateSequenceProcessed
parameter.description: Last update processed by client. If not provided, then all data will be returned for the event.

dataType.name: TennisScoreValues
dataType.description: Known keys observed/documented in Score.values for tennis. Values are returned as strings in the API.

parameter.name: player1
parameter.description: Player 1 ID.

parameter.name: player2
parameter.description: Player 2 ID.

parameter.name: bestOfSets
parameter.description: Number of sets for the match.

dataType.name: TennisIncidentValues
dataType.description: Known keys observed/documented in Incident.values for tennis. Values are returned as strings in the API.

parameter.name: matchid
parameter.description: Tournament ID:match ID:year.

parameter.name: id
parameter.description: Current incremental ID, updated on every change.

parameter.name: packet_id
parameter.description: A unique ID per match, per sent JSON packet, across packet types.

parameter.name: utc_timestamp
parameter.description: An HH:MM:SS timestamp from the server in UTC timezone.

parameter.name: doubles
parameter.description: Singles or doubles. Singles=1, Doubles=2.

parameter.name: nb_set
parameter.description: Number of sets for the match.

parameter.name: serve_first
parameter.description: Team who served first. 1=Team1, 2=Team2, !=not defined.

parameter.name: on_court
parameter.description: Time the players arrived on court.

parameter.name: num_court
parameter.description: Which court the match is on.

parameter.name: type_tie_break
parameter.description: Tiebreak in final set = 0, no tiebreak in final set = 1.

parameter.name: scoring_type
parameter.description: 1=Standard, 2=Standard with no advantage, 5=Match tiebreak instead of final set, 9=Modern set.

parameter.name: toss_chooser
parameter.description: Toss winner choice. 1=Serve, 2=Ends, !=gave choice to opponent.

parameter.name: match_state
parameter.description: The state of the match.

parameter.name: finished
parameter.description: Current state. Match not finished = 0, match finished > 0.

parameter.name: surname1
parameter.description: Display name, usually in the format A.SURNAME.

parameter.name: number1
parameter.description: Player ID.

parameter.name: number2
parameter.description: Player ID.

parameter.name: number1a
parameter.description: Player ID for the second player on team 1 in doubles.

parameter.name: number2a
parameter.description: Player ID for the second player on team 2 in doubles.

parameter.name: country1
parameter.description: Three character Olympic country code.

parameter.name: umpire
parameter.description: Umpire name in A.SURNAME format.

parameter.name: umpire_code
parameter.description: First 4 characters of surname plus first 2 characters of first name.

parameter.name: umpire_country
parameter.description: Three character Olympic country code.

parameter.name: undo
parameter.description: 0 or 1. If 1, previous packet has been undone.

exceptionType.name: APINGException
exceptionType.description: This exception is thrown when an operation fails.

parameter.name: errorCode
parameter.description: The API NG error code.

parameter.name: errorDetails
parameter.description: The stack trace of the error.

value.name: OK
value.description: Data returned successfully.

value.name: NO_NEW_UPDATES
value.description: No updates since the passed UpdateSequence.

value.name: NO_LIVE_DATA_AVAILABLE
value.description: Event scores are no longer available or are not on the schedule.

value.name: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
value.description: Data feed for the event type is currently unavailable.

value.name: UNEXPECTED_ERROR
value.description: An unexpected error occurred retrieving score data.

value.name: LIVE_DATA_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE
value.description: Live data feed for this event or match is temporarily unavailable; data could potentially be stale.

value.name: UNEXPECTED_ERROR
value.description: The operation failed with an unexpected error.

value.name: INVALID_INPUT_DATA
value.description: Invalid input data.

value.name: INVALID_SESSION_INFORMATION
value.description: The session token passed is invalid or expired.

value.name: INVALID_APP_KEY
value.description: The application key passed is invalid.

value.name: SERVICE_BUSY
value.description: The service is currently too busy to service this request.

value.name: TIMEOUT_ERROR
value.description: Internal call to downstream service timed out.

value.name: NO_SESSION
value.description: A session token is required for this operation.

value.name: NO_APP_KEY
value.description: An application key is required for this operation.

value.name: TOO_MANY_REQUESTS
value.description: Too many requests.

value.name: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
value.description: Service is currently unavailable.

value.name: C
value.description: On court: sent when the umpire is on court, approximately 10-15 minutes before the match starts.

value.name: W
value.description: Warmup: the players start warming up.

value.name: P
value.description: In progress: the match is in progress.

value.name: S
value.description: Suspended: the match has been suspended.

value.name: F
value.description: Finished: the match is finished.

value.name: D
value.description: Toilet break.

value.name: M
value.description: Medical timeout.

value.name: R
value.description: Challenge in progress, also used when there is Ball Mark Inspection.

value.name: L
value.description: Replay point.

value.name: E
value.description: Correction mode: when a point is undone, the match goes into correction mode while the umpire corrects the score.
